body:
Proves all 17 named-machine specifications, routes the retained existential rows through those contracts, and retires 356 private Catalog declarations plus six superseded public canonical-run aliases. The three already-gated forwarding exports retain time coefficient 22 and payload-space coefficient 1. The loop coefficient remains 10; the three frozen RAM admissions remain.

This draft includes the unmerged 23-theorem prerequisite **#230**, which must close gate 117 and merge first. The target is `complexity/arora-barak-ch3-4`; Seyoon merges. Relative to #230’s API tree, authored public declarations change exactly +3/−6. Surviving public headers, public order, runtime tables and data functions remain fixed, with the two approved import additions. The two private embedding injectivity proof fields change while their data fields stay fixed. The prescribed three private preparations gain head bounds; two later private headers use equivalent transported views.

The 12-file scope includes a mechanical body-only VirtualInput repair. Shared private certificates now serve terminal composition, bank reconstruction, forwarding rewind and canonical tape-update proofs. All three unrestricted tagged-run consumers use Mathlib’s existing invariant iterator. Two unused private selector proofs are retired. The compiler inventory distinguishes authored exports from generated proof/instance artifacts and two lazily materialized Convention equations; their availability and precise rule 10 assessment are documented.

Validation: the actual 12-module native dependency chain and final five-module tail pass with zero errors. All 4,413 owned compiled constants have standard axiom closures except the frozen RAM3; all 144 changed proof roots and 224 descendants have standard closures. Completed repair regions pass their recorded effective seals and controls. The two Catalog constant-space rows and redirect-space header remain excluded HOLDs; the generated rewind matcher has no effective discriminating negative control. No global legacy seal is claimed. Complete source freezes, compiler deltas, source-inclusive screens and failed experiments are retained under `campaign/fills/mig1/landing/`.

The final pushed source passed its fresh complete 394-module merged-tree replay: zero failures, zero static admission mismatches (static total 60), pipeline exit 0, from a whole campaign snapshot copy. Its final 25-file screen is complete: 1,696→622 directed candidates, 54 new/1,128 gone, with all new pairs classified and the six concrete tagged-instance matches disclosed for assessment. The earlier-generation replay and producer’s supplied sweeps remain separate evidence.

**Not yet clear to merge.** Gate 118 (Codex selected) is not ready for dispatch. Pending decisions are the two additional exact zero-space facts, a shared first-entry theorem for the remaining twin, and the exact redirect theorem home move. Their bounded owner/consumer proposals remain unapproved and unapplied. The delivery remains PARTIAL and no new debt acknowledgment is inferred.
